design: Fixed total prepared UPDATE operations; in-memory SQLite; per-worker statements and rows; same connections/statements through warmup and measurement; one VT per worker; ready/start barrier; wall ends after all joins; whole-process CPU delta over the measurement window divided by planned work only after full validation. Four carrier threads. No retries, admission, HTTP, pool, backups or timed denominator. Fresh sequential JVMs, cyclic variant rotations per scenario. JFR only in separate diagnostic JVMs. No latency sampling. Startup spread and worker durations are not per-operation latency.
quality_policy: Population CV >5%, any measured run shorter than5s, or fewer than2 repetitions is a descriptive caution, not a statistical significance test. No rows removed.

correctness.reason: Fork-only public API/restart semantics; performance cells still validate exact work and integrity

limitations: SQLite UPDATE plus JNI and driver bookkeeping are measured, not the bare lock primitive.
Nonfair ReentrantLock candidate includes an experimental JNI-compatible subclass; not a production compatibility commitment.
Headline JVMs have no JFR; diagnostic inflation cannot be assumed identical in uninstrumented JVMs.
Only one hosted run and one in-memory SQL workload; no general Gateway/disk or all-SQL performance claim.
The new Gateway overload collector was locally exercised; no new full overload CI matrix was run for this redesign.
